<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Australian frontier wars]]
**The [[Victoria State Government]] announces the establishment of a [[truth commission]] into genocidal violence against the state's [[Indigenous Australians|Indigenous population]] from the late 18th century to the early 20th century, as part of a process towards developing a [[Indigenous treaties in Australia|treaty]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/mar/09/victoria-launches-truth-commission-into-ongoing-effect-of-violent-colonisation-on-aboriginal-people (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**The [[Colombian Armed Forces|armed forces]] kill twelve people in an [[military operation|operation]] in the [[Guaviare Department]] against a group run by a former [[FARC]] leader. Defense Minister [[:es:Diego Molano Aponte|Diego Molano Aponte]] says that there were [[child soldier]]s present at the camp but declines to say if they were killed or state their ages. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/03/10/world/americas/colombia-children-military.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives]] votes 220–211 to pass the [[United States dollar|$]]1.9 trillion [[American Rescue Plan Act of 2021]], which extends weekly jobless benefit payments of $300 until September, sends $1,400 checks to individuals, and funds other coronavirus relief programs for states and businesses. The [[Stimulus (economics)|stimulus]] bill will be sent to [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] for his signature. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/house-set-to-approve-covid-19-relief-bill-11615372203 (''The Wall Street Journal'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-56350463 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*An overnight fire at an [[OVH]]cloud [[server farm]] in [[Strasbourg]] destroys a data center and damages another, taking millions of [[.fr]] websites offline in [[France]], including government websites, banks, online shops, and news websites. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-ovh-fire/millions-of-websites-offline-after-fire-at-french-cloud-services-firm-idUSKBN2B20NU?il=0 (Reuters)]
*A bus carrying dozens of pilgrims [[Bus plunge|plunges]] into a ravine in [[Indonesia]]'s [[Java]] island, killing at least 27 people. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1823511/world (''Arab News'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] surpasses 600,000 confirmed cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2021/03/michigan-crosses-600000-mark-for-new-coronavirus-cases-reports-7-new-deaths.html (MLive)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]], [[501.V2 variant]]
*****[[New Jersey]] reports its first case of the 501.V2 variant first detected in [[South Africa]]. [https://www.nj.com/coronavirus/2021/03/nj-confirms-1st-case-of-more-contagious-south-african-covid-variant-total-variant-cases-up-to-145.html (NJ)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saskatchewan]]
*****[[Saskatchewan]] surpasses 30,000 cases of COVID-19, and 400 related deaths. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7688619/coronavirus-covid-19-cases-saskatchewan-march-10-update/ (Global News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Karnataka]], [[501.V2 variant]]
*****[[Karnataka]] reports its first case of the 501.V2 variant first detected in [[South Africa]]. [https://www.livemint.com/news/india/karnataka-first-case-of-south-african-covid-19-variant-reported-11615394429724.html (''Mint'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]]
****[[Jordan]] approves the emergency use of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/covid-19-jordan-approves-russias-sputnik-v-vaccine-1.1615398075480 (''Gulf News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] reports a record 109 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 3,481. [https://www.bignewsnetwork.com/news/268065895/mongolia-sees-highest-daily-covid-19-cases-rise (Big News Network)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] begins COVID-19 [[vaccination]] rollout for those aged 60 years or older as part of the second phase of their vaccination programme. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/10/pakistan-kicks-off-senior-citizen-coronavirus-vaccinations (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya]]
****[[Kenya]] approves the emergency use of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] vaccine. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-03-10/kenya-approves-sputnik-v-vaccine-10th-african-nation-to-do-so (Bloomberg News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mauritius]]
****[[Mauritius]] imposes a two-week nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] for the second time since the pandemic began, with only essential services able to continue to operate, after the discovery of 14 local COVID-19 cases. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/mauritius-imposes-fresh-lockdown-after-14-local-covid-cases-01615368606 (''Barron's'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tanzania]]
****The [[President of Tanzania]] [[John Magufuli]] has not been seen in public since February 27. Opposition leaders call for the release of information as rumors grow that he is on a ventilator at a hospital in [[Nairobi]], [[Kenya]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/covid-denying-tanzanian-president-magufuli-145612481.html (Yahoo! News)] [https://news.trust.org/item/20210310112417-xr6gr/ (Thomson Reuters Foundation)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Togo]]
****[[Togo]] begins a vaccination campaign against COVID-19 using [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine. [[Prime Minister of Togo|Prime Minister]] [[Victoire Tomegah Dogbé]] is the first person to receive the vaccine. [https://www.togofirst.com/en/health/1003-7458-pm-dogbe-first-togolese-figure-to-get-covid-19-vaccine (Togo First)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]]
****[[Bulgaria]] reports 3,502 new cases in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total since December 11, and brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 266,805. [https://m.novinite.com/articles/208408/COVID-19+in+Bulgaria%3A+3%2C502+New+Cases (Novinite)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malta]]
****The [[Government of Malta]] announces that, due to record numbers of new cases, all theatres, museums, and gyms will be closed, all organised sports and religious activities will be banned, and gatherings will be limited to four people. The government also announces that all educational institutions will be closed as of March 15 and travel to [[Gozo]] will be restricted to residents and essential activities. [https://www.independent.com.mt/articles/2021-03-10/local-news/Government-to-announce-new-measures-tonight-Abela-6736231710 (''The Malta Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports 17,260 new cases in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total since November, and it subsequently brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,828,313. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/poland-sees-record-daily-covid-19-cases-since-november/2171181# (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
****[[Fiji]] begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against COVID-19 using the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine donated by the [[COVAX]] initiative. Ten frontline workers are the first to receive doses of the vaccine. [https://fijisun.com.fj/2021/03/10/first-doses-of-astrazeneca-covid-19-vaccine-administered-to-10-frontline-workers/ (''Fiji Sun'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Papua New Guinea]]
****The [[government of Papua New Guinea]] approves the use of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine. [[Prime Minister of Papua New Guinea|Prime Minister]] [[James Marape]] says that vaccination will not be compulsory and will initially be directed at health workers, people over 50 years of age and people with underlying health conditions. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/438009/png-approves-astrazeneca-covid-19-vaccine (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports a record 2,286 new [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours as [[intensive care unit]]s in 25 of 27 regional capitals reach near-full capacity, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 270,656. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/brazil-registers-daily-record-for-covid-19-deaths (''National Post'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-56342303 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Libyan Crisis (2011–present)|Libyan Crisis]]
**[[Libyan peace process]]
***At an [[Special session|extraordinary session]] in [[Sirte]], the Libyan parliament votes 121 to 11 to approve a new [[Government of National Unity (Libya)|Government of National Unity]] led by [[Prime Minister of Libya|Prime Minister]] [[Abdul Hamid Dbeibeh]]. The new interim unity government will govern [[Libya]] until a [[2021 Libyan general election|general election]] is held in December. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/10/libyan-lawmakers-endorse-govt-of-pm-designate-dbeibah (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Armenian coup d'état attempt]]
**The [[Government of Armenia|government]] says a decree by [[Prime Minister of Armenia|Prime Minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]] dismissing the [[Chief of the General Staff (Armenia)|Chief of the General Staff]] [[Onik Gasparyan]] is now legally effective despite [[President of Armenia|President]] [[Armen Sarksyan]] refusing to sign the decree into force. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-armenia-politics/armenia-government-says-decree-dismissing-top-general-comes-into-force-idUSKBN2B20EL?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[List of heads of government of Ivory Coast|Ivorian Prime Minister]] [[Hamed Bakayoko]] dies of cancer at a private hospital in [[Freiburg im Breisgau]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210310-ivory-coast-s-prime-minister-hamed-bakayoko-dies-in-hospital-in-germany-aged-56?ref=tw_i (France 24)]
